dct_description_sm: Contained within the 5th Edition (1978 to 1995) of the National Atlas of Canada is a map that shows the membership of the Parliament resulting from 22 May 1979 election. Map of Canada (with 20 urban insets) shows election results with Federal Electoral Districts coloured by the winning party. Matching table lists members elected and gives voting data. Charts summarize results of 1974 and 1979 elections by province and territory.
